The '''ionization buffer''' was a mechanism introduced by [[Kalibac Industries]] that protected a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] [[Central processor/Legends|central processing unit]] from most [[Ion blaster/Legends|ionization]] attacks. The technology was a significant breakthrough for [[Repulsorlift/Legends|floater]] droids, which could not be weighted down with heavy protective [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating.<ref name="Lords of the Expanse" />

KI's [[301-MAX Nightlight]] was equipped with an ionization buffer.<ref name="Lords of the Expanse" />
